stories.title: He sold me fresh fruit for years. I was there when immigration agents took him
stories.summary: NPR's Adrian Florido has been buying fruit from the same fruit cart vendor in his LA neighborhood for years. On Tuesday, Adrian was there when federal immigration agents swooped in and arrested him.

stories.title: A year after the DCA collision, families push for elusive changes to aviation safety
stories.summary: A year after the midair collision near Washington, D.C., families of the victims are pushing for action on aviation safety, including crash-avoidance technology. And they're digging in for a fight.

stories.title: Death of VA nurse Alex Pretti hovers over hearing on the Hill with VA secretary
stories.summary: VA secretary Doug Collins is appearing before senators to explain plans to overhaul the department. But some of the focus of the hearing was also on his comments about the killing of Alex Preeti.

stories.title: What comes next for Iran?
stories.summary: NPR's Mary Louise Kelly speaks with former Israeli intelligence official Sima Shine about tensions in Iran and what they could mean for the future of the regime.

stories.title: A Minneapolis restaurant adjusts to the new normal
stories.summary: Restaurants in Minneapolis have shifted their business strategies -- and their missions -- around the federal immigration push in the Twin Cities region.

stories.title: With his first Grammy nomination, Destin Conrad embraces personal evolution
stories.summary: Destin Conrad went from teen social media star to a musician touring the world on some of its biggest stages. In 2025, he put out both an R&B and jazz album and earned his first Grammy nomination.
